Maria (Partnerships): ok quick brain dump — thinking of an "annuity" style commit product for marketplace HW+SI bundles. customer commits monthly $ over 12mo, credits vest monthly, renewal incentives scale by sustained usage velocity. want a low-friction private-offer + sequenced seller credit for SIs. what pieces do we need to make this launchable?
Alex (Sales): love it. want predictable ARR for us and runway for partners. key ask: can we do staggered seller credits (eg 30/50/20) tied to usage & onboarding milestones? also need SKU mapping in marketplace so usage maps cleanly. :thumbsup:
Devin (Product): pair of concerns — 1) marketplace private offer APIs can accept custom SKUs and price overrides, but we need clear billing mapping so finance can reconcile credits vs committed revenue. 2) renewal trigger logic: define a deterministic signal. propose: usage >= 75% of committed for 3 of last 4 months => auto-renew offer routing to AM.
Sara (Field Ops): operationally we must avoid manual reconciliation. prefer monthly vesting credits that are escrowed in the CP (marketplace) and automatically released to sellers once onboarding checklist items pass. Milestones: (a) deployment verified, (b) training completed, (c) usage >= X. Otherwise credits clawback window 90d.
Maria (Partnerships): draft tiers i'm thinking:
````
tiers:
- 50k/mo -> 12% list discount + 10% seller credit (vests monthly)
- 100k/mo -> 18% list discount + 18% seller credit (staged: 50% onboarding / 30% usage / 20% renewal)
- 250k+/mo -> 25% list discount + 25% seller credit + co-marketing fund
renewal_signal: usage >= 80% of commit for 3/4 months
clawback: 90d from vesting if onboarding fails
````
Alex (Sales): that staged split is helpful. question: can we include a small upfront adoption accelerator (non-refundable) to help SIs fund PoC? maybe 5-10% of first month as prepaid credit that converts into seller credit after deployment verified.
Devin (Product): technically doable. need two quick infra items: 1) marketplace private-offer metadata field "seller_credit_profile" and 2) support for per-offer escrowed credit ledger that integrates with billing. ops-bot: created ticket INF-1427 to track ledger work.
ops-bot: INF-1427 created by ops-bot — "marketplace per-offer escrowed seller-credit ledger" assigned to eng-billing. :white_check_mark:
Sara (Field Ops): for renewals, also want an early-warning webhook to AMs when month-to-month velocity dips <60% for 2 consecutive months so we can run retention playbook. can that be a routing rule?
Devin (Product): yes — routing policy: if velocity < 60% for 2 months -> route to retention queue; if >=80% for 3 of 4 months -> route to renewal queue and generate private offer renewal with 1-touch accept.
Maria (Partnerships): next steps? volunteer owners pls: Alex -> partner GTM play, Sara -> ops checklist & escrow rules, Devin -> API/ledger spec, I'll draft customer-facing one-pager and example private-offer payload. aim to have a playbook v0 by EOD next Wed.
Alex (Sales): on it.
Sara (Field Ops): will start checklist doc and sample webhook payloads.
Devin (Product): will sketch API and share RFC in #eng-platform.
Maria (Partnerships): tagging @sara for webhook q and @devin for API q, ping me if blockers. :rocket:
Alex (Sales): +1 :thumbsup:
